title: Promote a tested process definition into the caller's own company: the REFUSAL half on QA (no promotion is performed)
description: The promotion copies the ACTIVE version of a definition from a test company into the caller's own company and activates it there; the destination is never a request value. The file proves what can be proved without changing a company: the platform administrator naming a source that does not exist (a random id, or something that is not an id) is answered 404; a company administrator naming another company (the platform fixture, when it exists) or a random id gets the identical zero-detail 404, so a prober learns nothing; a caller without a sign-in gets 401. The step that names a random well-formed source id as the platform administrator (s1) is BLOCKED by a PRODUCT DEFECT: QA answers 500 internal-error where the entry promises 404 (the malformed source id of s2 does answer 404); the step keeps the expected answer 404 and carries a blocked_by that names the defect. The process key is a throwaway name that no definition has, so even a source that existed would have nothing to copy. NOT automated, on purpose: the success path (201 with the promoted definition) activates a definition in the caller's own company, a new version that cannot be removed by a script, and the only own company with a source on QA is the platform company itself; it is covered by test/letflow/routers/tenants_test.exs and platform_scope_routes_test.exs. GAP: BP-PLATFORM-16 already carries the foreign-source refusals as part of the whole refusal matrix; this file is the entry's own file. Nothing is created or changed, so there is no cleanup and no residue; the fixture tenant is only READ (never created) and its steps are skipped with 'requires fixture_id' while it does not exist.

steps.says: Look for the platform fixture tenant by its fixed slug (404 is an answer, not a failure). It is only READ here: this file never creates, changes or removes it.
The platform administrator names a source company that does not exist (a fresh random id): 404, nothing is read or written (the destination is always the caller's own company).
steps.blocked_by: product defect, found by the dry run on 2026-11-26: the platform administrator naming a well-formed source id that no company has gets 500 internal-error instead of the 404 the entry promises (schema_name_for_tenant derives a schema name for any UUID and the read of the missing schema raises); remove this marker when the defect is fixed

steps.says: A source that is not even an id: the same 404.
A company administrator names ANOTHER company (the platform fixture) as the source: the zero-detail 404, before any read.
A company administrator names a random id: the identical 404.
A company administrator names something that is not an id: the identical 404.
Without a sign-in the promotion is refused: 401.
